frase_clave: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!
reflexion: Keep your heart awake to the Lord's presence at every moment, transforming your daily tasks into opportunities to love. How will you take care of your prayer today?

escenas.descripcion: Jesus sitting among his disciples on a grassy hill at sunset, speaking with intense care and earnest expression as he instructs them to keep watch.
A noble homeowner in a courtyard giving final instructions and responsibilities to his household servants and gatekeeper before setting off on a long journey.
A faithful gatekeeper holding a small burning oil lamp by a wooden door in the quiet night, looking out into the starlight with hopeful expectation.

titulo: A reading from the holy Gospel according to Mark.
texto_evangelio: At that time, watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is. “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch. Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning; lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping. What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

frase_es: Estad atentos, velad, porque no sabéis cuándo llegará el momento.
reflexion_es: Mantén tu corazón despierto a la presencia del Señor en cada momento. Vivir atentos a su amor transforma tus tareas diarias en una oportunidad para amar. ¿De qué manera vas a cuidar hoy tu oración?
